On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't pushed or knocked prone. Unprotected flames, such as torches, in the area are extinguished, and protected flames, such as those in lanterns, have a 50 percent chance of being extinguished.

traits.name: Living Projection
traits.description:
The yowler’s undead form is constantly covered with a magical illusion that makes it look like it did in life. This effect is suppressed for 1 minute if the yowler attacks or uses Yowl.

The changes wrought by this illusion fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the yowler’s fur appears soft and silky, but someone touching it would feel the yowler’s rotten fur and exposed bones. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern the yowler’s true appearance.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yowler makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its claws. It can use Yowl in place of a bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Yowl
actions.description: The yowler lets loose a horrid scream. Each hostile creature within 30 feet of the yowler that can hear it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the yowler's Yowl for the next 24 hours.

traits.name: Dream Leap
traits.description: Once on its turn, the yumerai can use half its movement to step magically into the dreams of a sleeping creature within 5 feet of it. It emerges from the dreams of another sleeping creature within 1 mile of the first sleeper, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second sleeper. If there is no other sleeping creature within range when it uses this trait, the yumerai is stunned until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.description:
The yumerai’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
At will: dancing lights, message, minor illusion
3/day each: detect thoughts, silent image, sleep
1/day each: confusion, major image

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yumerai makes two psychic lash attacks.

actions.name: Psychic Lash
actions.description: Melee Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (2d6) psychic damage.

actions.name: Somnambulism
actions.description: The yumerai targets one sleeping creature it can see within 30 feet of it. The yumerai can issue simple commands to the creature, such as 'Attack that creature,' 'Run over there,' or 'Fetch that object.' If the creature takes damage, receives a suicidal command, is told to move into damaging terrain, such as lava or a pit, or is grappled while carrying out the order, it can make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw, awakening and ending the yumerai's control on a success. The yumerai can control only one sleeping creature at a time. If it takes control of another, the effect on the previous target ends.

monster:tob2:zalikum.speed: 20 ft., Climb 10 ft., Fly 80 ft., Swim 10 ft.
monster:tob2:zalikum.languages: understands the languages of its creator but can't speak
monster:tob2:zalikum.damageResistances: bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing from nonmagical attacks
monster:tob2:zalikum.conditionImmunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Flyby
traits.description: The zalikum doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

traits.name: Ghastly Heated Body
traits.description: A creature that touches the zalikum or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage and 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.description: The zalikum can store the souls of up to 3 victims inside it at one time. If it has at least 1 soul, a destroyed zalikum gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hp and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of its sandy remains. If its sandy remains are soaked with holy water and buried in consecrated ground, its trapped souls are freed, and the zalikum can’t rejuvenate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zalikum makes one beak attack and one talon attack.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage and 3 (1d6) necrotic damage. If a creature is slain by this attack, its body crumbles to sand, and the zalikum stores its soul. The creature can be restored to life only if the zalikum is destroyed and can't rejuvenate (see the Rejuvenation trait).

actions.name: Talon
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) fire damage and 3 (1d6) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Death-infused Desert Breath
actions.description: The zalikum exhales superheated sand infused with the power of damned souls in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage and 14 (4d6) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. If a creature's saving throw fails by 5 or more, the creature also suffers one level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 1) piercing damage, and the target must make a successful DC 14 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned. While poisoned this way, the target is blind and takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself with a success.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) piercing damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the target is blinded and takes 7 (2d6) poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

monster:tob:zaratan.damageResistances: fire, lightning, thunder; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing

traits.name: Endless Breath
traits.description: The zaratan breathes air, but it can hold its breath for years.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.description: While the zaratan remains motionless on the surface of the ocean (except for drifting) it is indistinguishable from a small island.

traits.name: Fortified Shell
traits.description: The zaratan ignores any attack against its shell that doesn't do 30 points of damage or more. Attacking the zaratan's head or flippers bypasses this trait.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The zaratan does double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zaratan makes one bite attack and two flipper attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d10 + 10) piercing damage and the target is grappled (escape DC 20). Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained and the zaratan can't bite another target.

actions.name: Flipper
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +18 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d8 + 10) bludgeoning damage and the target must succeed on a DC 26 Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from the zaratan.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The zaratan makes one bite attack against a Huge or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target takes 26 (3d10 + 10) piercing damage, is swallowed, and the grapple ends. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, but has total cover against attacks and effects outside the zaratan. A swallowed creature takes 28 (8d6) acid damage at the start of each of the zaratan's turns. The zaratan can have any number of creatures swallowed at once. If the zaratan takes 40 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the zaratan must succeed on a DC 20 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 10 feet of the zaratan. If the zaratan dies, swallowed creatures are no longer restrained and can escape by using 30 feet of movement, exiting prone.

legendaryActions.name: Move
legendaryActions.description: The zaratan moves up to half its speed.

legendaryActions.name: Swipe
legendaryActions.description: The zaratan makes one flipper attack.

legendaryActions.name: Consume
legendaryActions.description: The zaratan makes one bite attack or uses Swallow.

traits.name: Darting Escape (Darting Form Only)
traits.description: The zeitgeist can take the Dash or Disengage action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

traits.name: Timewarped Body
traits.description:
At the start of each of the zeitgeist’s turns, roll a die. On an even roll, its body stretches and speeds up as it takes on a darting form. On an odd roll, its body becomes more solid and slows down as it takes on a sluggish form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except as noted here.
 Darting Form. While in a Darting form, the zeitgeist’s Armor Class increases by 2, and its speed is 40 feet.
 Sluggish Form. While in a Sluggish form, the zeitgeist has resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks, and its speed is 20 feet.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: In its darting form, the zeitgeist makes three darting rend attacks. In its sluggish form, the zeitgeist makes two sluggish slam attacks.

actions.name: Darting Rend
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage.

actions.name: Sluggish Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 feet., one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) force damage. If the zeitgeist scores a critical hit, the target is also knocked prone.

actions.name: Tormented Scream
actions.description: The zeitgeist cries out, releasing some of its internal torment in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw, taking 21 (6d6) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

reactions.name: Rewind
reactions.description: When the zeitgeist takes damage or when it starts its turn afflicted with a condition, it can rewind time around it, preventing the damage or undoing the condition. It can use this reaction even while paralyzed or stunned.

monster:tob3:zilaq.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 60 ft., Swim 15 ft.

traits.name: Eidetic Memory
traits.description: Remembers everything it hears or reads. It has advantage on Int (Arcana) and Int (History) checks.

traits.name: Two-Headed
traits.description: Advantage on Wis (Perception) checks and on saves vs. being blinded charmed deafened frightened stunned and knocked unconscious.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zimwi makes one claws attack and one bite attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature grappled by the zimwi, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the zimwi, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the zimwi's turns. If the zimwi's stomach takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the zimwi must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone in a space within 5 feet of the zimwi. Damage done to a zimwi's stomach does not harm the zimwi. The zimwi's stomach is larger on the inside than the outside. It can have two Medium creatures or four Small or smaller creatures swallowed at one time. If the zimwi dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage, and if the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the zimwi isn't already grappling a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 11).

traits.name: Desperate Hunger
traits.description: When the zimwi is below half its hp maximum, it has advantage on melee attack rolls against creatures that aren’t Constructs.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zimwi makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack. It can replace its Bite attack with a use of Swallow.

actions.name: Bite
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 12) if it is a Medium or smaller creature. The zimwi has two claws, each of which can grapple only one target.

actions.name: Swallow
actions.description: The zimwi makes one Bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the zimwi, and it takes 10 (3d6) acid damage at the start of each of the zimwi's turns. A zimwi can have up to two creatures swallowed at a time.

monster:ccdx:ziphius.damageResistances: cold; bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks

traits.name: Charge
traits.description: If the ziphius moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a dorsal fin attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 27 (5d10) slashing damage.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.description: The ziphius deals double damage to objects and structures.

traits.name: Telepathic Foresight
traits.description: As a bonus action at the start of its turn, the ziphius can choose one creature within 120 feet that it can see. The ziphius' eyes glow, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or the ziphius creates a temporary mental bond with the target until the start of the ziphius' next turn. While bonded, the ziphius reads the creature's surface thoughts, choosing to either gain advantage on attacks against that target or cause the target to have disadvantage on attacks against the ziphius.

traits.name: Water Breathing
traits.description: The ziphius can breathe only underwater.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The ziphius makes one beak attack and one claw attack.

actions.name: Claw
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description:
Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be swallowed by the ziphius. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the ziphius, and it takes 14 (4d6) acid damage at the start of each of the ziphius' turns. The ziphius can have only one target swallowed at a time.

If the ziphius takes 20 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the ziphius must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the swallowed creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of the ziphius. If the ziphius dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting prone.

actions.name: Dorsal Fin
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (3d10 + 4) slashing damage.

monster:tob:zmey.speed: 30 ft., Climb 15 ft., Fly 50 ft., Swim 30 ft.
monster:tob:zmey.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 90 ft., passive Perception 18

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.description: The zmey can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Lake Leap
traits.description: A zmey spends much of its time lurking in lakes and ponds. When submerged in a natural pool of standing water, it can transport itself as a bonus action to a similar body of water within 5,000 feet. Rapidly flowing water doesn't serve for this ability, but the zmey can leap to or from a river or stream where the water is calm and slow-moving.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (1/Day)
traits.description: If the zmey fails a saving throw, it can count it as a success instead.

traits.name: Multiheaded
traits.description: The zmey normally has three heads. While it has more than one head, the zmey has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, and stunned. If the zmey takes 40 or more damage in a single turn (and the damage isn't poison or psychic), one of its heads is severed. If all three of its heads are severed, the zmey dies.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.description: The zmey regains 15 hit points at the start of its turn. If the zmey takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of the zmey's next turn. Regeneration stops functioning when all heads are severed. It takes 24 hours for a zmey to regrow a functional head.

traits.name: Spawn Headling
traits.description: The severed head of a zmey grows into a zmey headling 2d6 rounds after being separated from the body. Smearing at least a pound of salt on the severed head's stump prevents this transformation.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The zmey makes one bite attack per head and one claws attack.

actions.name: Claws
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath

features.name: Frenzy
features.description: Starting when you choose this path at 3rd level, you can go into a frenzy when you rage. If you do so, for the duration of your rage you can make a single melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each of your turns after this one. When your rage ends, you suffer one level of exhaustion (as described in appendix A).

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, you can't be charmed or frightened while raging. If you are charmed or frightened when you enter your rage, the effect is suspended for the duration of the rage.

features.name: Intimidating Presence
features.description: Beginning at 10th level, you can use your action to frighten someone with your menacing presence. When you do so, choose one creature that you can see within 30 feet of you. If the creature can see or hear you, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier) or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn. On subsequent turns, you can use your action to extend the duration of this effect on the frightened creature until the end of your next turn. This effect ends if the creature ends its turn out of line of sight or more than 60 feet away from you.  If the creature succeeds on its saving throw, you can't use this feature on that creature again for 24 hours.

features.name: Retaliation
features.description: Starting at 14th level, when you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon Attack against that creature.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: When you join the College of Lore at 3rd level, you gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description: Also at 3rd level, you learn how to use your wit to distract, confuse, and otherwise sap the confidence and competence of others. When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of you makes an attack roll, an ability check, or a damage roll, you can use your reaction to expend one of your uses of Bardic Inspiration, rolling a Bardic Inspiration die and subtracting the number rolled from the creature's roll. You can choose to use this feature after the creature makes its roll, but before the GM determines whether the attack roll or ability check succeeds or fails, or before the creature deals its damage. The creature is immune if it can't hear you or if it's immune to being charmed.

features.name: Additional Magical Secrets
features.description: At 6th level, you learn two spells of your choice from any class. A spell you choose must be of a level you can cast, as shown on the Bard table, or a cantrip. The chosen spells count as bard spells for you but don't count against the number of bard spells you know.

features.name: Peerless Skill
features.description: Starting at 14th level, when you make an ability check, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration. Roll a Bardic Inspiration die and add the number rolled to your ability check. You can choose to do so after you roll the die for the ability check, but before the GM tells you whether you succeed or fail.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: When you choose this domain at 1st level, you gain proficiency with heavy armor.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: Also starting at 1st level, your healing spells are more effective. Whenever you use a spell of 1st level or higher to restore hit points to a creature, the creature regains additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Preserve Life
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to heal the badly injured. As an action, you present your holy symbol and evoke healing energy that can restore a number of hit points equal to five times your cleric level. Choose any creatures within 30 feet of you, and divide those hit points among them. This feature can restore a creature to no more than half of its hit point maximum. You can't use this feature on an undead or a construct.

features.name: Blessed Healer
features.description: Beginning at 6th level, the healing spells you cast on others heal you as well. When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that restores hit points to a creature other than you, you regain hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: At 8th level, you gain the ability to infuse your weapon strikes with divine energy. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cause the attack to deal an extra 1d8 radiant damage to the target. When you reach 14th level, the extra damage increases to 2d8.

features.name: Circle of the Land
features.description: The Circle of the Land is made up of mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites through a vast oral tradition. These druids meet within sacred circles of trees or standing stones to whisper primal secrets in Druidic. The circle's wisest members preside as the chief priests of communities that hold to the Old Faith and serve as advisors to the rulers of those folk. As a member of this circle, your magic is influenced by the land where you were initiated into the circle's mysterious rites.

features.name: Circle of the Land: Arctic
features.description: The Circle of the Land is made up of mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites through a vast oral tradition. These druids meet within sacred circles of trees or standing stones to whisper primal secrets in Druidic. The circle's wisest members preside as the chief priests of communities that hold to the Old Faith and serve as advisors to the rulers of those folk. As a member of this circle, your magic is influenced by the land where you were initiated into the circle's mysterious rites.

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.description: When you choose this circle at 2nd level, you learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, you can regain some of your magical energy by sitting in meditation and communing with nature. During a short rest, you choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level that is equal to or less than half your druid level (rounded up), and none of the slots can be 6th level or higher. You can't use this feature again until you finish a long rest. For example, when you are a 4th-level druid, you can recover up to two levels worth of spell slots. You can recover either a 2nd-level slot or two 1st-level slots.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: Your mystical connection to the land infuses you with the ability to cast certain spells. At 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level you gain access to circle spells connected to the land where you became a druid. Choose that land--arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, or swamp--and consult the associated list of spells. Once you gain access to a circle spell, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you gain access to a spell that doesn't appear on the druid spell list, the spell is nonetheless a druid spell for you.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: Your mystical connection to the land infuses you with the ability to cast certain spells. At 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level you gain access to circle spells connected to the land where you became a druid. Choose that land--arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, or swamp--and consult the associated list of spells. Once you gain access to a circle spell, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you gain access to a spell that doesn't appear on the druid spell list, the spell is nonetheless a druid spell for you.

features.name: Land's Stride
features.description: Starting at 6th level, moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement. You can also pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed by them and without taking damage from them if they have thorns, spines, or a similar hazard. In addition, you have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement, such those created by the entangle spell.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: Your mystical connection to the land infuses you with the ability to cast certain spells. At 3rd, 5th, 7th, and 9th level you gain access to circle spells connected to the land where you became a druid. Choose that land--arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, or swamp--and consult the associated list of spells. Once you gain access to a circle spell, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you gain access to a spell that doesn't appear on the druid spell list, the spell is nonetheless a druid spell for you.

Once you gain access to a circle spell, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If you gain access to a spell that doesn't appear on the druid spell list, the spell is nonetheless a druid spell for you.

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.description: When you reach 10th level, you can't be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and you are immune to poison and disease.

features.name: Nature's Sanctuary
features.description: When you reach 14th level, creatures of the natural world sense your connection to nature and become hesitant to attack you. When a beast or plant creature attacks you, that creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your druid spell save DC. On a failed save, the creature must choose a different target, or the attack automatically misses. On a successful save, the creature is immune to this effect for 24 hours. The creature is aware of this effect before it makes its attack against you.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Beginning when you choose this archetype at 3rd level, your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: Starting at 7th level, you can add half your proficiency bonus (round up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check you make that doesn't already use your proficiency bonus. In addition, when you make a running long jump, the distance you can cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Strength modifier.

features.name: Additional Fighting Style
features.description: At 10th level, you can choose a second option from the Fighting Style class feature.

features.name: Superior Critical
features.description: Starting at 15th level, your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

features.name: Survivor
features.description: At 18th level, you attain the pinnacle of resilience in battle. At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have no more than half of your hit points left. You don't gain this benefit if you have 0 hit points.

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.description: Starting when you choose this tradition at 3rd level, you can manipulate your enemy's ki when you harness your own. Whenever you hit a creature with one of the attacks granted by your Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of the following effects on that target: - It must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone. - It must make a Strength saving throw. If it fails, you can push it up to 15 feet away from you. - It can't take reactions until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Wholeness of Body
features.description: At 6th level, you gain the ability to heal yourself. As an action, you can regain hit points equal to three times your monk level. You must finish a long rest before you can use this feature again.

features.name: Tranquility
features.description: Beginning at 11th level, you can enter a special meditation that surrounds you with an aura of peace. At the end of a long rest, you gain the effect of a sanctuary spell that lasts until the start of your next long rest (the spell can end early as normal). The saving throw DC for the spell equals 8 + your Wisdom modifier + your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.description: At 17th level, you gain the ability to set up lethal vibrations in someone's body. When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 3 ki points to start these imperceptible vibrations, which last for a number of days equal to your monk level. The vibrations are harmless unless you use your action to end them. To do so, you and the target must be on the same plane of existence. When you use this action, the creature must make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, it is reduced to 0 hit points. If it succeeds, it takes 10d10 necrotic damage. You can have only one creature under the effect of this feature at a time. You can choose to end the vibrations harmlessly without using an action.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Sacred Weapon
features.description: As an action, you can imbue one weapon that you are holding with positive energy, using your Channel Divinity. For 1 minute, you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls made with that weapon (with a minimum bonus of +1). The weapon also emits bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light 20 feet beyond that. If the weapon is not already magical, it becomes magical for the duration. You can end this effect on your turn as part of any other action. If you are no longer holding or carrying this weapon, or if you fall unconscious, this effect ends.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn the Unholy
features.description: As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer censuring fiends and undead, using your Channel Divinity. Each fiend or undead that can see or hear you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage. A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there's nowhere to move, the creature can use the Dodge action.

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.description: Starting at 7th level, you and friendly creatures within 10 feet of you can't be charmed while you are conscious. At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

features.name: Purity of Spirit
features.description: Beginning at 15th level, you are always under the effects of a protection from evil and good spell.

features.name: Holy Nimbus
features.description: At 20th level, as an action, you can emanate an aura of sunlight. For 1 minute, bright light shines from you in a 30-foot radius, and dim light shines 30 feet beyond that. Whenever an enemy creature starts its turn in the bright light, the creature takes 10 radiant damage. In addition, for the duration, you have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by fiends or undead.

features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.description: At 3rd level, you gain one of the following features of your choice. Colossus Slayer Giant Killer Horde Breaker

features.name: Hunter's Prey: Colossus Slayer
features.description: Your tenacity can wear down the most potent foes. When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, the creature takes an extra 1d8 damage if it's below its hit point maximum. You can deal this extra damage only once per turn.

features.name: Hunter's Prey: Giant Killer
features.description: When a Large or larger creature within 5 feet of you hits or misses you with an attack, you can use your reaction to attack that creature immediately after its attack, provided that you can see the creature.

features.name: Hunter's Prey: Horde Breaker
features.description: Once on each of your turns when you make a weapon attack, you can make another attack with the same weapon against a different creature that is within 5 feet of the original target and within range of your weapon.

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.description: At 7th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice. Escape the Horde Multiattack Defense Steel Will

features.name: Defensive Tactics: Escape the Horde
features.description: Opportunity attacks against you are made with disadvantage.

features.name: Defensive Tactics: Multiattack Defense
features.description: When a creature hits you with an attack, you gain a +4 bonus to AC against all subsequent attacks made by that creature for the rest of the turn.

features.name: Defensive Tactics: Steel Will
features.description: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

features.name: Multiattack
features.description: At 11th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice. Volley Whirlwind Attack

features.name: Multiattack: Volley
features.description: You can use your action to make a ranged attack against any number of creatures within 10 feet of a point you can see within your weapon's range. You must have ammunition for each target, as normal, and you make a separate attack roll for each target.

features.name: Multiattack: Whirlwind Attack
features.description: You can use your action to make a melee attack against any number of creatures within 5 feet of you, with a separate attack roll for each target.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.description: At 15th level, you gain one of the following features of your choice. Evasion Stand Against the Tide Uncanny Dodge

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense: Evasion
features.description: When you are subjected to an effect, such as a red dragon's fiery breath or a lightning bolt spell, that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense: Stand Against the Tide
features.description: When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to force that creature to repeat the same attack against another creature (other than itself) of your choice.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: When an attacker that you can see hits you with an attack, you can use your reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can use the bonus action granted by your Cunning Action to make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, use your thieves' tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Use an Object action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.description: When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, you gain the ability to climb faster than normal; climbing no longer costs you extra movement. In addition, when you make a running jump, the distance you cover increases by a number of feet equal to your Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.description: Starting at 9th level, you have advantage on a Dexterity (Stealth) check if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.description: By 13th level, you have learned enough about the workings of magic that you can improvise the use of items even when they are not intended for you. You ignore all class, race, and level requirements on the use of magic items.

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.description: When you reach 17th level, you have become adept at laying ambushes and quickly escaping danger. You can take two turns during the first round of any combat. You take your first turn at your normal initiative and your second turn at your initiative minus 10. You can't use this feature when you are surprised.

features.name: Dragon Ancestor
features.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later. You can speak, read, and write Draconic. Additionally, whenever you make a Charisma check when interacting with dragons, your proficiency bonus is doubled if it applies to the check.

features.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later. You can speak, read, and write Draconic. Additionally, whenever you make a Charisma check when interacting with dragons, your proficiency bonus is doubled if it applies to the check.

features.name: Dragon Ancestor: White - Cold Damage
features.description: At 1st level, you choose one type of dragon as your ancestor. The damage type associated with each dragon is used by features you gain later. You can speak, read, and write Draconic. Additionally, whenever you make a Charisma check when interacting with dragons, your proficiency bonus is doubled if it applies to the check.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.description: As magic flows through your body, it causes physical traits of your dragon ancestors to emerge. At 1st level, your hit point maximum increases by 1 and increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level in this class. Additionally, parts of your skin are covered by a thin sheen of dragon-like scales. When you aren't wearing armor, your AC equals 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.description: Starting at 6th level, when you cast a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell. At the same time, you can spend 1 sorcery point to gain resistance to that damage type for 1 hour.

features.name: Dragon Wings
features.description: At 14th level, you gain the ability to sprout a pair of dragon wings from your back, gaining a flying speed equal to your current speed. You can create these wings as a bonus action on your turn. They last until you dismiss them as a bonus action on your turn. You can't manifest your wings while wearing armor unless the armor is made to accommodate them, and clothing not made to accommodate your wings might be destroyed when you manifest them.

features.name: Draconic Presence
features.description: Beginning at 18th level, you can channel the dread presence of your dragon ancestor, causing those around you to become awestruck or frightened. As an action, you can spend 5 sorcery points to draw on this power and exude an aura of awe or fear (your choice) to a distance of 60 feet. For 1 minute or until you lose your concentration (as if you were casting a concentration spell), each hostile creature that starts its turn in this aura must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed (if you chose awe) or frightened (if you chose fear) until the aura ends. A creature that succeeds on this saving throw is immune to your aura for 24 hours.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.description: Starting at 1st level, when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you gain temporary hit points equal to your Charisma modifier + your warlock level (minimum of 1).

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.description: Starting at 6th level, you can call on your patron to alter fate in your favor. When you make an ability check or a saving throw, you can use this feature to add a d10 to your roll. You can do so after seeing the initial roll but before any of the roll's effects occur. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Fiendish Resilience
features.description: Starting at 10th level, you can choose one damage type when you finish a short or long rest. You gain resistance to that damage type until you choose a different one with this feature. Damage from magical weapons or silver weapons ignores this resistance.

features.name: Hurl Through Hell
features.description: Starting at 14th level, when you hit a creature with an attack, you can use this feature to instantly transport the target through the lower planes. The creature disappears and hurtles through a nightmare landscape. At the end of your next turn, the target returns to the space it previously occupied, or the nearest unoccupied space. If the target is not a fiend, it takes 10d10 psychic damage as it reels from its horrific experience. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.description: Beginning when you select this school at 2nd level, the gold and time you must spend to copy an evocation spell into your spellbook is halved.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.description: Beginning at 2nd level, you can create pockets of relative safety within the effects of your evocation spells. When you cast an evocation spell that affects other creatures that you can see, you can choose a number of them equal to 1 + the spell's level. The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their saving throws against the spell, and they take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.description: Starting at 6th level, your damaging cantrips affect even creatures that avoid the brunt of the effect. When a creature succeeds on a saving throw against your cantrip, the creature takes half the cantrip's damage (if any) but suffers no additional effect from the cantrip.

features.name: Empowered Evocation
features.description: Beginning at 10th level, you can add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any wizard evocation spell you cast.

features.name: Overchannel
features.description: Starting at 14th level, you can increase the power of your simpler spells. When you cast a wizard spell of 1st through 5th level that deals damage, you can deal maximum damage with that spell. The first time you do so, you suffer no adverse effect. If you use this feature again before you finish a long rest, you take 2d12 necrotic damage for each level of the spell, immediately after you cast it. Each time you use this feature again before finishing a long rest, the necrotic damage per spell level increases by 1d12. This damage ignores resistance and immunity.

features.name: Ancestral Protectors
features.description: While raging, the first creature you hit on your turn has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you until the start of your next turn, and anyone else it hits has resistance to that attack's damage. Ends early if your rage ends.

features.name: Spirit Shield
features.description: While raging, when a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, use your reaction to reduce it by 2d6 (3d6 at 10th level, 4d6 at 14th).

features.name: Consult the Spirits
features.description: Cast augury or clairvoyance without a slot or material components (Wisdom); clairvoyance summons an invisible ancestral spirit instead of a sensor. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Vengeful Ancestors
features.description: When Spirit Shield reduces an attack's damage, the attacker takes force damage equal to the amount prevented.

features.name: Storm Aura
features.description: While raging, a 10-foot aura activates on entering rage and again as a bonus action each turn; save DC 8 + proficiency + Con. Choose an environment (change on leveling): Desert, other creatures in the aura take 2 fire (3 at 5th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th); Sea, one creature makes a Dex save, 1d6 lightning, half on success (2d6 at 10th, 3d6 at 15th, 4d6 at 20th); Tundra, chosen creatures gain 2 temporary HP (3 at 5th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th).

features.name: Storm Soul
features.description: Desert: fire resistance, ignore extreme heat, set an unattended flammable object alight with an action. Sea: lightning resistance, breathe underwater, swim speed 30 feet. Tundra: cold resistance, ignore extreme cold, freeze a 5-foot cube of water for 1 minute with an action.

features.name: Shielding Storm
features.description: Creatures of your choice in your aura share your Storm Soul resistance.

features.name: Raging Storm
features.description: Desert: after a creature in your aura hits you, reaction for a Dex save or fire damage equal to half your barbarian level. Sea: after you hit a creature in your aura, reaction for a Str save or it falls prone. Tundra: each time the aura activates, one creature in it makes a Str save or its speed is 0 until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Divine Fury
features.description: While raging, the first creature you hit with a weapon each turn takes an extra 1d6 + half your barbarian level, necrotic or radiant (chosen when you gain this).

features.name: Warrior of the Gods
features.description: Spells that only restore you to life (not undeath) need no material components.

features.name: Fanatical Focus
features.description: Once per rage, reroll a failed saving throw and use the new roll.

features.name: Zealous Presence
features.description: Bonus action: up to ten other creatures of your choice within 60 feet that can hear you have advantage on attacks and saves until the start of your next turn. Once per long rest.

features.name: Rage beyond Death
features.description: While raging, 0 hit points doesn't knock you unconscious; you still make death saves, but you don't die until your rage ends, and then only if still at 0 HP.

features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
features.description: Bonus action, spend a Bardic Inspiration: up to Cha mod (min 1) creatures within 60 feet that can see you gain 5 temporary HP (8 at 5th, 11 at 10th, 14 at 15th) and can use a reaction to move their speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

features.name: Enthralling Performance
features.description: After performing for 1 minute, up to Cha mod (min 1) humanoids within 60 feet that watched make a Wis save or are charmed for 1 hour, idolizing you; ends if damaged or if you attack them or their allies. Failed targets don't know. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Mantle of Majesty
features.description: Bonus action: cast command without a slot, then again as a bonus action each turn for 1 minute (concentration). Creatures charmed by you automatically fail. Once per long rest.

features.name: Unbreakable Majesty
features.description: Bonus action, 1 minute or until incapacitated: a creature attacking you for the first time on a turn makes a Cha save or must pick another target (or waste the attack); on a success it has disadvantage on saves against your spells on your next turn. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Medium armor and the scimitar; a proficient simple or martial melee weapon can be your bard spellcasting focus.

features.name: Blade Flourish
features.description: When you take the Attack action, +10 feet walking speed this turn; once per turn on a weapon hit, spend a Bardic Inspiration die for extra damage equal to the roll plus one flourish: Defensive (add the roll to AC until your next turn), Slashing (same damage to another creature within 5 feet), or Mobile (push 5 feet plus the roll, then reaction to move your speed to a space within 5 feet of the target).

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Master's Flourish
features.description: Roll a d6 for a Blade Flourish instead of spending Bardic Inspiration.

features.name: Psychic Blades
features.description: Once per round on your turn, on a weapon hit, spend a Bardic Inspiration for an extra 2d6 psychic (3d6 at 5th, 5d6 at 10th, 8d6 at 15th).

features.name: Words of Terror
features.description: After talking 1 minute alone with a humanoid, it makes a Wis save or is frightened of you or another creature you choose for 1 hour or until it or an ally is attacked or damaged. Failed targets don't know. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Mantle of Whispers
features.description: Reaction when a humanoid dies within 30 feet: capture its shadow until a long rest. As an action, become a disguise of that person for 1 hour, with what it would share with a casual acquaintance; Insight vs your Deception +5 sees through it. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Shadow Lore
features.description: Action, one creature within 30 feet that can hear and understand you makes a Wis save or is charmed for 8 hours (ends if you or allies harm it or force a save), believing you know its deepest secret; it obeys you short of risking its life. Once per long rest.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.description: Always prepared: identify, searing smite (1st); heat metal, magic weapon (3rd); elemental weapon, protection from energy (5th); fabricate, wall of fire (7th); animate objects, creation (9th).

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Heavy armor and smith's tools.

features.name: Blessing of the Forge
features.description: At the end of a long rest, touch a nonmagical suit of armor or simple or martial weapon: it becomes magic (+1 AC, or +1 to attack and damage) until your next long rest or your death.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Artisan's Blessing
features.description: A 1-hour ritual crafts a nonmagical metal-containing item worth up to 100 gp (weapon, armor, ten ammunition, tools, other metal object), consuming metal or coins of equal value; can duplicate a metal item you hold, such as a key.

features.name: Soul of the Forge
features.description: Resistance to fire damage; +1 AC while wearing heavy armor.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.description: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 fire (2d8 at 14th level).

features.name: Saint of Forge and Fire
features.description: Immunity to fire damage; while wearing heavy armor, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing from nonmagical attacks.

features.name: Domain Spells
features.description: Always prepared: bane, false life (1st); gentle repose, ray of enfeeblement (3rd); revivify, vampiric touch (5th); blight, death ward (7th); antilife shell, raise dead (9th).

features.name: Circle of Mortality
features.description: Healing dice from your spells use their maximum on a creature at 0 hit points. You learn spare the dying (not counted against your cantrips), with 30-foot range and castable as a bonus action.

features.name: Eyes of the Grave
features.description: Action: until the end of your next turn you know the location of undead within 60 feet not behind total cover or shielded from divination. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
features.description: Action, curse one creature within 30 feet until the end of your next turn: the next attack by you or an ally that hits it deals vulnerable damage, then the curse ends.

features.name: Sentinel at Death's Door
features.description: Reaction when you or a creature within 30 feet suffers a critical hit: make it a normal hit, cancelling crit-triggered effects. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Potent Spellcasting
features.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to cleric cantrip damage.

features.name: Keeper of Souls
features.description: When an enemy you can see dies within 60 feet, you or a creature within 60 feet regains HP equal to its Hit Dice count, if you aren't incapacitated. Once per turn cycle (until the start of your next turn).

features.name: Balm of the Summer Court
features.description: A pool of d6s equal to your druid level, refilled on a long rest. Bonus action: spend up to half your druid level in dice on a creature within 120 feet; it regains the total in HP plus 1 temporary HP per die.

features.name: Hearth of Moonlight and Shadow
features.description: At the start of a rest, an invisible 30-foot-radius sphere: you and allies inside have +5 to Stealth and Perception, and firelight inside isn't visible outside. Ends with the rest or if you leave.

features.name: Hidden Paths
features.description: Bonus action: teleport up to 60 feet; or action: teleport a willing creature you touch up to 30 feet. Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Walker in Dreams
features.description: After a short rest, cast dream (you as messenger), scrying, or teleportation circle without a slot or material components; the circle opens to where you last finished a long rest on this plane. Once per long rest.

features.name: Speech of the Woods
features.description: You speak, read and write Sylvan; beasts understand you and you can read their noises and motions.

features.name: Spirit Totem
features.description: Bonus action: summon a spirit at a point within 60 feet with a 30-foot aura for 1 minute (bonus action moves it 60 feet). Once per short or long rest. Bear: chosen creatures gain 5 + druid level temporary HP, and you and allies have advantage on Str checks and saves in the aura. Hawk: reaction to give advantage on an attack against a target in the aura; you and allies have advantage on Perception there. Unicorn: advantage on checks to detect creatures in the aura, and when your slotted spell heals anyone, chosen creatures in the aura also regain HP equal to your druid level.

features.name: Mighty Summoner
features.description: Beasts and fey your spells summon or create get 2 extra HP per Hit Die, and their natural weapons count as magical.

features.name: Guardian Spirit
features.description: A beast or fey you summoned that ends its turn in your Spirit Totem aura regains HP equal to half your druid level.

features.name: Faithful Summons
features.description: When reduced to 0 HP or incapacitated against your will, gain conjure animals as a 9th-level casting: four beasts of CR 2 or lower within 20 feet protect you for 1 hour, no concentration. Once per long rest.

features.name: Arcane Archer Lore
features.description: Proficiency in Arcana or Nature, and the prestidigitation or druidcraft cantrip.

features.name: Arcane Shot
features.description: Learn two Arcane Shot options (one more at 7th, 10th, 15th and 18th). Once per turn, when you fire a shortbow or longbow arrow as part of the Attack action, apply an option (decided on hit unless it has no attack roll). Two uses per short or long rest. Save DC 8 + proficiency + Int. Options, extra damage doubling at 18th: Banishing (Cha save or banished to the Feywild until the end of its next turn; +2d6 force at 18th), Beguiling (+2d6 psychic, Wis save or charmed by an ally within 30 feet until your next turn), Bursting (2d6 force to the target and everything within 10 feet), Enfeebling (+2d6 necrotic, Con save or its weapon damage is halved until your next turn), Grasping (+2d6 poison, speed -10 feet and 2d6 slashing whenever it moves, for 1 minute or until removed with Athletics vs your DC), Piercing (no attack roll: 1-by-30-foot line through cover, Dex save for arrow damage +1d6 piercing, half on success), Seeking (no attack roll: hits a creature seen in the last minute around corners, Dex save for arrow damage +1d6 force and you learn its location, half on success), Shadow (+2d6 psychic, Wis save or it can't see beyond 5 feet until your next turn).

features.name: Magic Arrow
features.description: Nonmagical arrows you fire from a shortbow or longbow count as magical.

features.name: Curving Shot
features.description: When you miss with a magic arrow, bonus action to reroll against a different target within 60 feet of the first.

features.name: Ever-Ready Shot
features.description: If you roll initiative with no Arcane Shot uses left, regain one.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: One of Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or one language.

features.name: Born to the Saddle
features.description: Advantage on saves to avoid falling off your mount; land on your feet from a fall of 10 feet or less if not incapacitated; mounting or dismounting costs 5 feet of movement.

features.name: Unwavering Mark
features.description: When you hit with a melee weapon, mark the creature until the end of your next turn: within 5 feet of you it has disadvantage attacking anyone but you. If it damages someone else, on your next turn a bonus-action melee attack against it has advantage and deals extra damage equal to half your fighter level. Str mod special attacks (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Warding Maneuver
features.description: Reaction when you or a creature within 5 feet is hit, while wielding a melee weapon or shield: add 1d8 to the target's AC against it; if it still hits, the target has resistance to that damage. Con mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Hold the Line
features.description: Creatures provoke your opportunity attack when they move 5 feet or more within your reach, and a hit reduces their speed to 0 for the turn.

features.name: Ferocious Charger
features.description: Once per turn, after moving 10 feet straight before a hit, the target makes a Str save (DC 8 + proficiency + Str) or falls prone.

features.name: Vigilant Defender
features.description: A special reaction usable once on every other creature's turn, only for an opportunity attack, and not on a turn you use your normal reaction.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: One of History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion, or one language.

features.name: Fighting Spirit
features.description: Bonus action: advantage on weapon attacks this turn and 5 temporary HP (10 at 10th level, 15 at 15th). Three uses per long rest.

features.name: Elegant Courtier
features.description: Add your Wisdom modifier to Persuasion checks; proficiency in Wisdom saves (or Intelligence or Charisma if you already have it).

features.name: Tireless Spirit
features.description: If you roll initiative with no Fighting Spirit uses left, regain one.

features.name: Rapid Strike
features.description: Once per turn during the Attack action, give up advantage on one attack to make an extra weapon attack against that target.

features.name: Strength before Death
features.description: When damage drops you to 0 HP without killing you, reaction: take an extra turn immediately, interrupting the current one; damage at 0 HP still causes death save failures. Fall unconscious after it if still at 0. Once per long rest.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Performance and brewer's supplies.

features.name: Drunken Technique
features.description: Flurry of Blows also grants the Disengage action and +10 feet walking speed this turn.

features.name: Tipsy Sway
features.description: Stand up from prone for 5 feet of movement. When a creature misses you with a melee attack, spend 1 ki as a reaction to have it hit another creature of your choice within 5 feet of you.

features.name: Drunkard's Luck
features.description: Spend 2 ki to cancel disadvantage on an ability check, attack roll or saving throw.

features.name: Intoxicated Frenzy
features.description: Flurry of Blows can make up to three more attacks (five total) if each one targets a different creature this turn.

features.name: Path of the Kensei
features.description: Choose one melee and one ranged kensei weapon (simple or martial without heavy or special; longbow allowed), gaining proficiency; they count as monk weapons. One more at 6th, 11th and 17th. Agile Parry: after an unarmed strike in the Attack action while holding a melee kensei weapon, +2 AC until your next turn. Kensei's Shot: bonus action, ranged kensei hits deal +1d4 this turn. Way of the Brush: calligrapher's or painter's supplies.

features.name: One with the Blade
features.description: Kensei weapon attacks count as magical. Deft Strike: once per turn on a kensei weapon hit, spend 1 ki for extra damage equal to your Martial Arts die.

features.name: Sharpen the Blade
features.description: Bonus action: spend up to 3 ki to give a kensei weapon you touch that bonus to attack and damage for 1 minute (not on a weapon that already has a bonus).

features.name: Unerring Accuracy
features.description: Once per turn, reroll a missed monk weapon attack.

features.name: Radiant Sun Bolt
features.description: A ranged spell attack option in the Attack action: 30 feet, Dex to attack and damage, radiant, Martial Arts die. After using it in the Attack action, spend 1 ki to make it twice as a bonus action. With Extra Attack, any of your attacks can be this.

features.name: Searing Arc Strike
features.description: Right after the Attack action, spend 2 ki to cast burning hands as a bonus action, +1 spell level per extra ki (max ki half your monk level).

features.name: Searing Sunburst
features.description: Action: a 20-foot-radius sphere at a point within 150 feet; Con save or 2d6 radiant (opaque total cover protects). Spend up to 3 ki for +2d6 each.

features.name: Sun Shield
features.description: Bright light 30 feet and dim 30 more (toggle as a bonus action). While lit, reaction when hit by a melee attack: deal 5 + Wis mod radiant to the attacker.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Always prepared: armor of Agathys, command (3rd); hold person, spiritual weapon (5th); bestow curse, fear (9th); dominate beast, stoneskin (13th); cloudkill, dominate person (17th).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Conquering Presence: action, chosen creatures within 30 feet make a Wis save or are frightened for 1 minute, repeating the save each turn. Guided Strike: +10 to an attack roll after seeing the roll.

features.name: Aura of Conquest
features.description: A 10-foot aura (30 feet at 18th) while not incapacitated: creatures frightened of you have speed 0 in it and take psychic damage equal to half your paladin level when they start their turn there.

features.name: Scornful Rebuke
features.description: A creature that hits you takes psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (min 1), if you aren't incapacitated.

features.name: Invincible Conqueror
features.description: Action, 1 minute: resistance to all damage, one extra attack in the Attack action, and melee weapon crits on 19 or 20. Once per long rest.

features.name: Oath Spells
features.description: Always prepared: sanctuary, sleep (3rd); calm emotions, hold person (5th); counterspell, hypnotic pattern (9th); Otiluke's resilient sphere, stoneskin (13th); hold monster, wall of force (17th).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Emissary of Peace: bonus action, +5 to Persuasion for 10 minutes. Rebuke the Violent: reaction right after an attacker within 30 feet damages someone other than you; it makes a Wis save, taking radiant damage equal to what it dealt, half on a success.

features.name: Aura of the Guardian
features.description: Reaction when a creature within 10 feet (30 at 18th) takes damage: you take that damage instead; it can't be reduced and no other effects transfer.

features.name: Protective Spirit
features.description: If you end your turn in combat below half your hit points and aren't incapacitated, regain 1d6 + half your paladin level HP.

features.name: Emissary of Redemption
features.description: Resistance to all damage dealt by other creatures, and a creature that hits you takes radiant damage equal to half the damage you took. Both stop working against a creature you attack, cast a spell on, or damage, until you finish a long rest.

features.name: Gloom Stalker Magic
features.description: Known extra spells: disguise self (3rd), rope trick (5th), fear (9th), greater invisibility (13th), seeming (17th).

features.name: Dread Ambusher
features.description: Add Wis mod to initiative. On your first turn of each combat, +10 feet walking speed, and the Attack action includes one extra weapon attack that deals +1d8 on a hit.

features.name: Umbral Sight
features.description: Darkvision 60 feet (or +30 feet if you have it). In darkness you are invisible to creatures relying on darkvision to see you.

features.name: Iron Mind
features.description: Proficiency in Wisdom saves (or Intelligence or Charisma if you already have it).

features.name: Stalker's Flurry
features.description: Once per turn, when you miss with a weapon attack, make another weapon attack as part of the same action.

features.name: Shadowy Dodge
features.description: Reaction, before the result is known, when attacked without advantage: impose disadvantage.

features.name: Horizon Walker Magic
features.description: Known extra spells: protection from evil and good (3rd), misty step (5th), haste (9th), banishment (13th), teleportation circle (17th).

features.name: Detect Portal
features.description: Action: learn the distance and direction to the nearest planar portal within 1 mile. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Planar Warrior
features.description: Bonus action, choose a creature within 30 feet: your next weapon hit on it this turn deals all force damage plus 1d8 force (2d8 at 11th).

features.name: Ethereal Step
features.description: Bonus action: cast etherealness without a slot, ending at the end of the turn. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Distant Strike
features.description: During the Attack action, teleport up to 10 feet before each attack; if you attack two different creatures, make one extra attack against a third.

features.name: Spectral Defense
features.description: Reaction when an attack damages you: resistance to all of that attack's damage this turn.

features.name: Monster Slayer Magic
features.description: Known extra spells: protection from evil and good (3rd), zone of truth (5th), magic circle (9th), banishment (13th), hold monster (17th).

features.name: Hunter's Sense
features.description: Action, a creature within 60 feet: learn its damage immunities, resistances and vulnerabilities (none, if it is shielded from divination). Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Slayer's Prey
features.description: Bonus action, mark a creature within 60 feet until a short or long rest or a new mark: the first weapon hit on it each turn deals +1d6.

features.name: Supernatural Defense
features.description: Add 1d6 to saves your Slayer's Prey target forces and to checks to escape its grapple.

features.name: Magic-User's Nemesis
features.description: Reaction when a creature within 60 feet casts a spell or teleports: Wis save against your spell DC or it fails and is wasted. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Slayer's Counter
features.description: When your Slayer's Prey target forces a save, reaction: one weapon attack against it first; on a hit you automatically succeed on the save.

features.name: Ear for Deceit
features.description: On Insight checks to tell if a creature lies, treat a d20 of 7 or lower as 8.

features.name: Eye for Detail
features.description: Bonus action: a Perception check to spot a hidden creature or object, or an Investigation check for clues.

features.name: Insightful Fighting
features.description: Bonus action: your Insight vs a visible creature's Deception; on a win you can Sneak Attack it without advantage (not with disadvantage) for 1 minute or until you use this on another target.

features.name: Steady Eye
features.description: Advantage on Perception and Investigation if you move no more than half your speed this turn.

features.name: Unerring Eye
features.description: Action: sense illusions, shapechangers in another form, and other deceiving magic within 30 feet, unless blinded or deafened (not what is hidden). Wis mod uses (min 1) per long rest.

features.name: Eye for Weakness
features.description: Sneak Attack deals +3d6 against your Insightful Fighting target.

features.name: Master of Intrigue
features.description: Disguise kit, forgery kit, one gaming set and two languages; after 1 minute of listening you can mimic a creature's speech and accent in a language you know.

features.name: Master of Tactics
features.description: Help as a bonus action; when you help an ally attack, the target can be within 30 feet of you if it can see or hear you.

features.name: Insightful Manipulator
features.description: After 1 minute observing or talking to a creature outside combat, learn whether it is your equal, superior or inferior in two of: Int, Wis, Cha, class levels.

features.name: Misdirection
features.description: Reaction when targeted by an attack while a creature within 5 feet gives you cover: the attack targets that creature instead.

features.name: Soul of Deceit
features.description: Your thoughts can't be read unless you allow it, and you can present false thoughts (Deception vs Insight). Truth-detecting magic shows you as truthful if you wish, and magic can't compel you to tell the truth.

features.name: Skirmisher
features.description: Reaction when an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet: move up to half your speed without provoking.

features.name: Survivalist
features.description: Proficiency in Nature and Survival, with double proficiency bonus on checks using them.

features.name: Superior Mobility
features.description: +10 feet walking speed, and climbing and swimming speeds if you have them.

features.name: Ambush Master
features.description: Advantage on initiative; attacks against the first creature you hit in the first round have advantage until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Sudden Strike
features.description: When you take the Attack action, one extra attack as a bonus action; it can Sneak Attack even if you already did this turn, but not the same target twice.

features.name: Fancy Footwork
features.description: A creature you make a melee attack against can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of your turn.

features.name: Rakish Audacity
features.description: Add Cha mod to initiative. Sneak Attack without advantage when you're within 5 feet of the target, no other creature is within 5 feet of you, and you don't have disadvantage.

features.name: Panache
features.description: Action: Persuasion vs Insight against a creature that hears and understands you. Hostile: for 1 minute it has disadvantage attacking anyone but you and can only make opportunity attacks against you (ends if an ally attacks or spells it, or you're 60+ feet apart). Not hostile: charmed for 1 minute as a friendly acquaintance, ending if harmed.

features.name: Elegant Maneuver
features.description: Bonus action: advantage on your next Acrobatics or Athletics check this turn.

features.name: Master Duelist
features.description: Reroll a missed attack with advantage. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Divine Magic
features.description: When you learn or replace a sorcerer spell or cantrip, you can pick from the cleric list; it becomes a sorcerer spell. Pick an affinity for a bonus spell that doesn't count against spells known: good cure wounds, evil inflict wounds, law bless, chaos bane, neutrality protection from evil and good.

features.name: Favored by the Gods
features.description: When you fail a save or miss an attack, add 2d4 to the total. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Empowered Healing
features.description: Once per turn, when you or an ally within 5 feet rolls healing dice for a spell, spend 1 sorcery point to reroll any of them once, if you aren't incapacitated.

features.name: Otherworldly Wings
features.description: Bonus action: spectral wings give a 30-foot flying speed until you're incapacitated, die or dismiss them.

features.name: Unearthly Recovery
features.description: Bonus action below half your hit points: regain half your hit point maximum. Once per long rest.

features.name: Eyes of the Dark
features.description: Darkvision 120 feet. At 3rd level you learn darkness (not counted against spells known) and can cast it for 2 sorcery points, seeing through it when you do.

features.name: Strength of the Grave
features.description: When damage drops you to 0 HP, Cha save (DC 5 + damage taken) to drop to 1 HP instead; not against radiant damage or a critical hit. Once per long rest after a success.

features.name: Hound of Ill Omen
features.description: Bonus action, 3 sorcery points: summon a Medium monstrosity dire wolf within 30 feet of a target you can see within 120 feet, with temporary HP equal to half your sorcerer level. It moves through creatures and objects (5 force if it ends in one), always knows the target's location, moves and attacks only that target, and while within 5 feet the target has disadvantage on saves against your spells. Lasts 5 minutes or until it or the target drops to 0.

features.name: Shadow Walk
features.description: In dim light or darkness, bonus action: teleport up to 120 feet to a space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness.

features.name: Umbral Form
features.description: Bonus action, 6 sorcery points, 1 minute: resistance to all damage except force and radiant, and move through creatures and objects (5 force if you end a turn inside one).

features.name: Wind Speaker
features.description: Speak, read and write Primordial (understanding Aquan, Auran, Ignan and Terran).

features.name: Tempestuous Magic
features.description: Bonus action right before or after casting a spell of 1st level or higher: fly up to 10 feet without provoking.

features.name: Heart of the Storm
features.description: Resistance to lightning and thunder. When you start casting a 1st-level-plus spell that deals lightning or thunder, chosen creatures within 10 feet take lightning or thunder damage equal to half your sorcerer level.

features.name: Storm Guide
features.description: Action: stop rain in a 20-foot sphere around you. Bonus action each round: set the wind's direction in a 100-foot sphere until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Storm's Fury
features.description: Reaction when hit by a melee attack: lightning damage equal to your sorcerer level to the attacker, and a Str save against your spell DC or it is pushed up to 20 feet.

features.name: Wind Soul
features.description: Immunity to lightning and thunder; magical flying speed 60 feet. Action: drop to 30 feet for 1 hour to give 3 + Cha mod creatures within 30 feet a 30-foot flying speed for 1 hour. Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description: Added to your warlock list: cure wounds, guiding bolt (1st); flaming sphere, lesser restoration (2nd); daylight, revivify (3rd); guardian of faith, wall of fire (4th); flame strike, greater restoration (5th).

features.name: Bonus Cantrips
features.description: Light and sacred flame, not counted against cantrips known.

features.name: Healing Light
features.description: A pool of 1 + warlock level d6s, refilled on a long rest. Bonus action: heal a creature within 60 feet, spending up to Cha mod dice (min 1).

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.description: Resistance to radiant; add Cha mod to one radiant or fire damage roll of your spells against one target.

features.name: Celestial Resilience
features.description: After a short or long rest, gain temporary HP equal to warlock level + Cha mod, and up to five creatures you can see gain half your warlock level + Cha mod.

features.name: Searing Vengeance
features.description: Instead of a death save at the start of your turn, regain half your hit point maximum and stand if you like; chosen creatures within 30 feet take 2d8 + Cha mod radiant and are blinded until the end of the turn. Once per long rest.

features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description: Added to your warlock list: shield, wrathful smite (1st); blur, branding smite (2nd); blink, elemental weapon (3rd); phantasmal killer, staggering smite (4th); banishing smite, cone of cold (5th).

features.name: Hexblade's Curse
features.description: Bonus action, curse a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute: add proficiency bonus to damage against it, your attacks against it crit on 19 or 20, and if it dies you regain warlock level + Cha mod HP (min 1). Once per short or long rest.

features.name: Hex Warrior
features.description: Medium armor, shields and martial weapons. After a long rest, touch a proficient weapon without two-handed: use Cha for its attack and damage until the next long rest; with Pact of the Blade this applies to every pact weapon.

features.name: Accursed Specter
features.description: When you slay a humanoid, its spirit rises as a specter with temporary HP equal to half your warlock level and a bonus to attacks equal to your Cha mod; it obeys you until your next long rest. Once per long rest.

features.name: Armor of Hexes
features.description: Reaction when your cursed target hits you: roll a d6, and on 4 or higher the attack misses.

features.name: Master of Hexes
